name: fiscal_debt_to_gdp
source: Department of Finance Canada — Budget 2025, Annex 1, Chart A1.5 (Long-Term Federal Debt Projections)
definition: Federal debt (accumulated deficit) as % of GDP. Federal-only basis; excludes provincial, territorial, local, and CPP/QPP. Year labels are fiscal-year-ending convention (e.g. 'FY1994-95' = year ending 31 March 1995, corresponds to '1995' in the chart's x-axis).
notes: Year-label normalization: Budget 2025 Annex 1 Chart A1.5 uses calendar-year-of-fiscal-year-ending convention on its x-axis. This file normalizes to FYYYYY-YY labels consistent with Plate-3 and Plate-5 source cards. The chart's '1995' is rendered here as FY1994-95; '2024' is FY2023-24; '2030' is FY2029-30.
